Works with governments so that imported animal products meet the same welfare standards as domestic ones, in New Zealand, the UK and the EU. Ambitious Impact published one public model of its work; the most recent, from October 2022, puts it at **<span data-figure="headline" data-model="animal-policy-international-aim">13</span> years of healthy life per $1,000**.

| Model | By | Date | Years of healthy life per $1,000 | Cells reproduced |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Animal Policy International: banning low-welfare animal imports into New Zealand (Ambitious Impact, 2022 idea report)](/animal-policy-international) | AIM | October 2022 | <span data-figure="headline" data-model="animal-policy-international-aim">13</span> | 245, 40 kept fixed |

**Purely theoretical.** Ambitious Impact's estimate is of the idea, written before Animal Policy International existed, not of the charity's own results. It is shown because Animal Policy International runs the programme today ([checked October 2026](https://www.animalpolicyinternational.org/)) and no model of its actual work exists yet.
